reviews.text: Today I went for my kitten! 8:40 am, operation went perfectly. A fantastic team, excellent doctors!!! They are professional, attentive, and explain everything. A big thank you to Baki... I highly recommend them!!!

I came in as an emergency today for my rabbit who was in gastrointestinal distress after being turned away by the Massilia veterinary clinic. So I went to this clinic. The veterinary assistants were very pleasant and found solutions quickly. They found an appointment slot for me the same day, even though it was an emergency.

I was seen by Dr. Bayol, a very dedicated, gentle, attentive, and professional gentleman who explained things very clearly.

I'm so glad you were there for my little rabbit.

There should be more people like you.

Thank you so much.

A loyal client for almost thirty years.
I have always been very satisfied with the care my animals receive.
Dr. Bayol is very professional and attentive to both the animals and their owners.
I highly recommend this clinic; you won't be disappointed.
I was very well received by Marine, who is fantastic with animals!

A very bad experience.

I had an appointment at 10:00 AM and called to let them know I would be a little late because I was having a lot of trouble getting my cat into his carrier. They offered me an 11:00 AM slot. After more than an hour and a half of struggling, I called again to confirm I was coming, and they finally told me the slot had been given to someone else.

They then offered me 3:00 PM, telling me to leave my cat in his carrier until then. With the heat and the very small carrier in which my cat was already extremely uncomfortable, that was out of the question. When I explained that I had already spent an hour and a half trying to get him into his carrier, they showed absolutely no understanding.

I am very disappointed by this lack of organization and consideration. I do not recommend this clinic.

Great clinic, except that today they taught me—or rather, she taught me—that nail trimming is only done on small dogs like Chihuahuas, but never on larger breeds, and that the nails wear down naturally. So I went to see a groomer. After telling him what happened, he still doesn't believe me.

Dr. Bayer is very professional and answers questions, providing explanations.

I highly recommend it.

I would like to thank the entire team at the clinic for their support and guidance during the end of our beloved dog Flash's life. This team, and especially Dr. Floreal Crunière, showed immense compassion and allowed us the most beautiful goodbye, letting Flash pass away in our arms. We were deeply touched by the handwritten letter that included his paw prints. Thank you so much for everything.
They're the best.

Thank you to Dr. Bayol who saw me as an emergency patient. I left the consultation reassured about my Mia's problem. Well done to the whole team.

Terrible veterinary clinic, the reception was nonexistent. I was late for my appointment because it was difficult to get my cat into the carrier. I called back to say I was on my way, and they told me they would see me between appointments. I waited 30 minutes only to be told that they wouldn't see me after all, or that I could only see them at 6 PM, even though my cat needed urgent care. This clinic only cares about money. I ended up going to another clinic only to be told that my cat had something completely different from what they had told me. If you live in the area, I strongly advise against going to this clinic. They are incapable of providing proper care, or even any care at all, to my cat. Go instead to the one in St. Antoine, where they welcomed me very well without an appointment.
Thank you to Mr. Philippe Rayol for his professionalism and detailed diagnosis, excellent service, thank you! I highly recommend them, they are fantastic.

Hello,

Dr. Bayol possesses the rare qualities required of a veterinarian. He is very humane, reassuring, and kind to both animals and their owners.
I have complete trust in him and entrust my animals to him without hesitation, knowing they are in excellent hands.
Dr. Bayol has cared for all my four-legged friends since the clinic opened, and I have never been disappointed. Whenever I have the opportunity, I recommend him because he truly is a wonderful person.

I mustn't forget the entire reception team, who are always fantastic, not to mention the clinic manager, my dear Virginie, whom I love like a daughter. I also mustn't forget Dr. Crumière, who is also a very good vet, and who is likewise very reassuring and respectful towards animals and their owners. In short: if you're looking for a top-notch veterinary clinic, look no further than the Grand-Litoral Clinic for your pets – you won't regret it.

Sincerely, Michelle Reynaud

I took my cat back there twice because he's tired and won't eat.
They tell me there's absolutely nothing wrong, that everything will be fine with time, and of course, they charge me for everything, otherwise it wouldn't be any fun.

I've finally found a veterinarian with the human qualities and skills that some have unfortunately lost... Thank you to you and your team, and see you soon for the follow-up of my little tribe 🐈🐈🐰🐇
